Gentle strength and balance exercises for people over 60 — so you can move with confidence and feel your best.

I'm Cathy, and my mission as a physical therapist with over 25 years of experience is to guide you through safe, effective workouts you can do at home. Whether you're returning to fitness, managing pain, or working on fall prevention, these simple routines are designed to meet you where you are.

You’ll find balance training, core and leg strength, joint-friendly mobility, and exercises to support brain health—all in a supportive, approachable format.

DISCLAIMER: The videos on this channel are for general education and demonstration purposes only. They are not medical advice or a substitute for personalized care. Always consult your healthcare provider before beginning any new exercise program. If anything feels painful or uncomfortable, stop immediately. Perform all exercises at your own risk.
